Only regular/permanent Civil Engineering officers/executives of Indian Railways/PSUs/Metros/RRTS with at least 3 years of work experience in construction of Railway/Metro/High Speed/RRTS/DFCCIL projects may apply. how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-II, which asks for personal data, educational qualifications, experience details, previous deputation/foreign assignment, debarment from deputation and completion of cooling off period, and sign the certificate.
Applicants for immediate absorption also complete the Undertaking (Annexure-IV) and the Affidavit (Annexure-V).
Send an advance copy of the application to Sr. Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd., 2nd Floor, Churchgate, Mumbai-400 020, latest by 12 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About MRVC
content_sections.text: Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. (MRVC) is a public sector undertaking of the Government of India under the Ministry of Railways, with its office on the 2nd Floor, Churchgate Station Bldg., Mumbai. In its own words, MRVC is a vital project implementation organisation working in the sensitive Mumbai Suburban area with a very lean organisational structure.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The posts are open only to Civil Engineering officers/executives of Indian Railways/PSUs/Metros/RRTS who are regular/permanent employees. The three posts are advertised together; each grade has its own feeder-grade requirement, listed below. Applicants must hold the posts substantively. Additional General Manager (Civil) – Officers/Executives holding substantively: posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA), OR posts in Level-13 (CDA) with minimum 12 years' service in Group 'A', OR posts in IDA E-6 grade (Rs.90000-240000) for a period of 04 years with overall 16 years of managerial service. Joint General Manager (Civil) – Officers/Executives holding substantively: posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA), OR posts in Level 12 (CDA) with minimum 8 years' service in Group 'A', OR posts in IDA E-5 grade (Rs.80000-220000) for a period of 04 years with overall 14 years of managerial service. Deputy General Manager (Civil) – Officers/Executives holding substantively: posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA), OR posts in Level 11 (CDA) with minimum 08 years of Gr. A/B service, OR posts in IDA E-4 grade (Rs.70000-200000) for a period of four years with overall 12 years of managerial service, OR posts in Level 10 (CDA) with minimum 12 years of Group B Service (for deputation only). At least 3 (three) years of work experience in Construction of Railway/Metro/High Speed/RRTS/DFCCIL Projects. 3 years' experience in execution of suburban Railway projects/works (preferable). Experience in dealing with Projects/Works funded by multinational banks/financial institutions like World Bank, ADB, NDB, AIIB etc. (preferable). The cut-off date for age and eligibility is the closing date of the Vacancy Notice; the application proforma asks for age as on 12.12.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; candidates should check the official notification for the grade-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay scales: Additional General Manager – Level 13A (CDA)/IDA E7 100000-260000; Joint General Manager – Level 13 (CDA)/IDA E6 90000-240000; Deputy General Manager – Level 12 (CDA)/IDA E-5 80000-220000. On deputation: Parent Pay plus Deputation (Duty) Allowance. On absorption: Scale of pay of the post in which absorbed. Terms of appointment: Deputation / Absorption. Duration: Maximum 5 years subject to exemption from the Rule of Immediate Absorption beyond 30-06-2027 (if selected on deputation). Officers selected for immediate absorption undertake to tender their technical resignation in their parent organisation (Annexure-IV). Place of posting: Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: MRVC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these duties and responsibilities for the posts: Planning, estimation, tendering, execution and contract management for Railway Projects/Works involving earthwork, bridges, stations for Mumbai Suburban, including ensuring quality and safety of the assigned work. Supervision and Contract Management. Dealing with arbitration/court cases related to construction works. Liaison with State/Local Authorities/Railway Officials. Any other works as assigned from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MRVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MRVC Vacancy Notification No. 28/2026 has 3 posts of Additional General Manager/Joint General Manager/Deputy General Manager (Civil).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MRVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advance copy of the application must be sent latest by 12 December 2026, which is the closing date of the Vacancy Notice.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the MRVC AGM/JGM/DGM (Civil) posts?
faq.answer: Only regular/permanent Civil Engineering officers/executives of Indian Railways/PSUs/Metros/RRTS who hold substantively the analogous or specified feeder grade posts can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required for the MRVC Civil posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must have at least 3 (three) years of work experience in Construction of Railway/Metro/High Speed/RRTS/DFCCIL Projects; suburban Railway project experience and work on World Bank, ADB, NDB, AIIB-funded projects are preferable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MRVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For deputation the limit is not more than 56 years; for absorption it is not more than 57 years for AGM, 55 years for JGM and 50 years for DGM, reckoned as on the closing date of the Vacancy Notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for MRVC AGM, JGM and DGM (Civil)?
faq.answer: The scales are Level 13A (CDA)/IDA E7 100000-260000 for AGM, Level 13 (CDA)/IDA E6 90000-240000 for JGM and Level 12 (CDA)/IDA E-5 80000-220000 for DGM; on deputation, officers get parent pay plus Deputation (Duty) Allowance.

faq.question: Q7. Can the application be sent by email to MRVC?
faq.answer: Yes, a scanned copy of the duly filled in and signed application in PDF format may also be sent to [email protected], in addition to the advance copy to Sr. Manager (HR), MRVC, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the deputation period at MRVC?
faq.answer: Deputation is for a maximum of 5 years, subject to exemption from the Rule of Immediate Absorption beyond 30-06-2027 for those selected on deputation.

faq.question: Q9. What extra documents do absorption applicants submit?
faq.answer: Officers applying for immediate absorption submit an Undertaking (Annexure-IV) to tender technical resignation in the parent organisation and an Affidavit (Annexure-V) declaring freedom from D&AR/SPE/Vigilance angle.
